scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run server:dev" "npm run client:dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.setup: echo 'Setting up environment files...' && npm run setup:server && npm run setup:client
scripts.setup:server: cd server && cp env.template .env.local && echo 'Created server/.env.local - please edit with your values'
scripts.setup:client: cd client && cp env.template .env.local && echo 'Created client/.env.local - please edit with your values'
